name: Blynk
tagline: HTTPS API for IoT datastreams, device control, and dashboards
description: Blynk is a no-code IoT platform with cloud HTTPS APIs for reading and writing datastreams, controlling devices, and powering mobile dashboards. Developers use tokens and REST-style endpoints to manage hardware from apps and automations.

auth.details: Device or organization token via query param or header; confirm exact mechanism from current docs

use_cases: write pin or virtual pin values to devices
trigger device updates from server automations
build custom dashboards on Blynk cloud data
